# Shiheng Zhang

<p class="hero-role">Postdoctoral Researcher, Department of Applied Mathematics, University of Washington</p>

<p class="hero-summary">I work on numerical analysis, kinetic equations, and dynamical low-rank approximation, with an emphasis on structure-preserving algorithms for scientific computing.</p>

`Numerical analysis`
`Kinetic equations`

`Scientific computing`

## Research {#research}

::: {.section-shell}
::: {.content-shell}
::: {.split-grid}
::: {.stack-block}
### Current Focus

- Structure-preserving schemes for kinetic equations and Wasserstein gradient flows
- Dynamical low-rank methods for stiff and multiscale PDEs
- Reliable numerical algorithms with strong stability and asymptotic properties
:::

::: {.stack-block}
### Background

<div class="timeline-item">
  <p class="timeline-year">2024–present</p>
  <p class="timeline-text">Postdoctoral Researcher in Applied Mathematics at the University of Washington, working with <a href="https://jingweihu-math.github.io/webpage/">Jingwei Hu</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="timeline-item">
  <p class="timeline-year">2023</p>
  <p class="timeline-text">Ph.D. in Mathematics, Purdue University, advised by <a href="https://www.math.purdue.edu/~shen7/">Jie Shen</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="timeline-item">
  <p class="timeline-year">2019</p>
  <p class="timeline-text">B.S. in Mathematics, Southern University of Science and Technology, advised by <a href="https://faculty.sustech.edu.cn/?tagid=yangj7&orderby=date&iscss=1&snapid=1&go=2&lang=en">Jiang Yang</a> and <a href="http://maths.nju.edu.cn/~hebma/">Bingsheng He</a>.</p>
